title: Color norms in product categories and brand equity differentiation
statement:
Color norms exist within product categories; differentiation from category color norms can help or harm brand equity depending on involvement and presence of a dominant leader.

Options:
- Conform to norm: category-norm blue (fits: high involvement, trust category)
- Mild differentiation: differentiated teal (fits: challenger brand)
- Strong differentiation: category-atypical warm (fits: low involvement, disruptive)
- Norm with accent: norm + accent contrast (fits: balanced equity)
appliesWhen: Applies to: fintech, health, luxury. Audience: adults, b2b buyers.
